s: unchristian, unholy, ungodly (contrary to Christian teaching)
unusual or unacceptable; (especially of time) very early or very late
Ach, du bist es! Ich dachte schon, wer zu dieser unchristlichen Zeit noch anruft.
Oh, it's you! I already wondered who'd call at this ungodly hour.
